usedFor: Shopify takes the payment and Zoho Books does the accounting, so “Order Paid” can feed “Create Invoice”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Invoice” in Zoho Books
bestTemplate.why: A paid order becomes an invoice for the customer, so bookkeeping needs no retyping.

watchOut: “Create Invoice” is made for a customer, so create them first with “Create or Update Customer”.
